description: Source code for the Mattermost server API handling channel bookmark operations, including creation, update, deletion, sorting, and listing of channel bookmarks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API handler class for channel bookmark operations.

methods.name: InitChannelBookmarks
methods.description: Initializes API routes for channel bookmark operations based on feature flags.

methods.name: createChannelBookmark
methods.description: Handles creation of a new channel bookmark, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: updateChannelBookmark
methods.description: Handles updating an existing channel bookmark with permission and validity checks.

methods.name: updateChannelBookmarkSortOrder
methods.description: Updates the sort order of a channel bookmark, with permission validation.

methods.name: deleteChannelBookmark
methods.description: Deletes a specified channel bookmark after permission validation.

methods.name: listChannelBookmarksForChannel
methods.description: Lists all bookmarks for a specific channel, checking read permissions.
